title: QUIZ - 48
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a two-step linear equation involving decimal coefficients
questions.question: Solve for a: \( 2.7a - 0.8 = -30.5 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract -0.8 from both sides: 2.7a = -29.7. Divide by 2.7: a = -11.
questions.hint: Treat the decimal coefficients the same way as whole numbers: undo addition, then division.

questions.hint: Treat the decimal coefficients the same way as whole numbers: undo addition, then division.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a real-world equation involving decimal prices and fees
questions.question: A subscription costs $8.38 plus $2.22 per item. If the total bill was $17.26, how many items (t) were purchased?
questions.explanation: The equation is 2.22t + 8.38 = 17.26. Subtracting 8.38: 2.22t = 8.88. Dividing by 2.22: t = 4.
questions.hint: Set up an equation with the fee as a constant and the price as the coefficient, then solve.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a real-world equation involving decimal prices and fees
questions.question: A subscription costs $9.24 plus $17.58 per item. If the total bill was $61.98, how many items (n) were purchased?
questions.explanation: The equation is 17.58n + 9.24 = 61.98. Subtracting 9.24: 17.58n = 52.74. Dividing by 17.58: n = 3.
questions.hint: Set up an equation with the fee as a constant and the price as the coefficient, then solve.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step equation requiring combining decimal coefficients
questions.question: Solve for a: \( 4.8a + 5.7a - 0.5 = -53.0 \)
questions.explanation: Combine coefficients: 4.8+5.7 = 10.5. So 10.5a + -0.5 = -53.0, giving 10.5a = -52.5, so a = -5.
questions.hint: Combine the decimal coefficients of the like terms first, then isolate the variable.
